s.qty <> 0 AND s.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId} AND s.location_id = #{q.locationId} AND s.material_id = #{q.materialId}

SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.category, m.image_url, m.safety_stock, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(s.frozen_qty), 0) AS frozen_qty, AS unit_cost, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.type <> 'CONSIGN_IN' THEN s.qty ELSE 0 END), 0) * COALESCE(, 0), 2) AS amount FROM wms_material m LEFT JOIN wms_stock s ON s.material_id = m.id AND s.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId} LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_material_cost mc ON mc.material_id = m.id
m.is_virtual = 0 AND m.id = #{q.materialId}
AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND m.category IN ()
GROUP BY m.id, m.code, m.name, m.spec, m.unit, m.category, m.image_url, m.safety_stock, m.ref_cost, mc.id, mc.unit_cost, mc.qty
HAVING m.safety_stock IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) < m.safety_stock
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) <> 0
mapper.select: SELECT s.material_id AS "materialId", SUM(s.qty) AS "qty", SUM(s.frozen_qty) AS "frozenQty" FROM wms_stock s JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id WHERE s.material_id IN #{id} AND w.type NOT IN ('DEFECT', 'CONSIGN_OUT', 'CONSIGN_IN') GROUP BY s.material_id

SELECT s.location_id AS "locationId", l.code AS "locationCode", s.batch_no AS "batchNo", b.expiry_date AS "expiryDate", s.qty - s.frozen_qty AS "qty" FROM wms_stock s LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = s.location_id LEFT JOIN wms_batch b ON b.material_id = s.material_id AND b.batch_no = s.batch_no AND s.batch_no <> '' WHERE s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND s.material_id = #{materialId} AND s.qty - s.frozen_qty > 0 AND (b.expiry_date IS NULL OR b.expiry_date >= #{today}) AND (l.loc_type IS NULL OR l.loc_type <> 'DEFECT') ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.expiry_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, b.expiry_date, s.batch_no, l.sort, l.code
